$comment: The two RELATIONSHIP SENTINELS, in every UI language. ONE table, two consumers:
client/src/constants/relationships.ts (the wizard matrix) and
server/lib/relationships.js (every prompt path). Same one-source shape as
shared/topic-age-windows.json.
WHY IT EXISTS — 2026-09-19. The server compared the ENGLISH literal
'Not Known to' to decide whether a matrix cell said anything. The wizard
stores the LOCALIZED label, so the guard never fired for de/fr/it and every
cell the user had not answered was sent to the arc author as a positive
assertion ('Levin is Nicht bekannt mit Max', ten of them in one de-ch story).
Hand-copying the label list into the server would have made a second
maintained copy; this file makes it one.
notSet     the DEFAULT the matrix auto-fills. The user has not answered.
Emits NOTHING to any prompt.
strangers  a DELIBERATE choice. The user has stated these two are strangers.
It is a fact about the cast, so it IS sent to the writer.
Symmetric and reciprocal: rendered as one sentence per pair.
legacyNotSet
values saved before the split, when one value was both the
auto-fill default and the only way to say 'strangers'. The two are
not distinguishable retroactively, so every stored occurrence reads
as notSet (owner 2026-09-19) — it emits nothing, which is what the
English path already did. No migration invents a deliberate choice.
Both sentinels are their own inverse. Swiss German: ss, never the eszett.
